content:
olivia: FYI support reported tenant ten-alpha sees badge flip between v1/v2 during canary windows. console shows burst of v2 but routing traces show steady v1.
ben: suspicious. any telemetry ids?
olivia: sample req 09ZXY123ABC. interestingly badge flips align with rollout canary windows (10s every minute).
raghu: probable cause: aggregator shard uses 1m bucketing, console badge uses 5s rolling sample for UX. when canary toggles traffic-route for a short probe, the badge sampling picks it up and shows v2. backend routing steady uses final route and falls back to v1. mismatch caused by different sampling windows.
emma: also saw double-counting in quota dashboard due to per-shard flush ordering; quick probes increment v2 quota briefly. finance flagged potential rounding noise.
eng-sre-bot: [alert] short-lived version_signal spikes detected during canary probes (metric: short_probe_spike).
ben: mitigation: 1) align console badge read to routed_version emitted post-route and use 1m window for badge; 2) change quota commit to use final routed_version; 3) reduce probe duration to avoid UX-visible blips.
olivia: prefer 1 + telemetry to measure prevalence. I'll patch console to read routed_version when present and add tooltip "badge reflects executed model in last minute". ETA 3h.
raghu: I'll add a per-tenant debounce on quota commits: only commit attempted_version if routed_version matches within 15s, else emit tentative tag. small PR coming.
emma: will coordinate with finance on rounding tolerance.
support-bot: [note] CS notified about potential badge confusion.
olivia: rolling canary change now; monitoring for 30m. thanks all. :thumbsup:
__notes: Single-thread Slack export. Messages prefixed by sender; no title field as per agents.md. All fields are strings or list of strings.
